'''Far Mothma''' was a member of the [[Mothma family/Legends|Mothma family]] from the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Chandrila/Legends|Chandrila]]. By the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], a few [[Standard month/Legends|months]] after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Far Mothma was [[Death/Legends|dead]] and [[Burial/Legends|buried]] on the [[Mothma prairie estate|family's grounds]] in the Chandrilan prairies. When [[Ensign/Legends|Ensign]] [[Nanda (ensign)|Nanda]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] was sent to Chandrila to investigate the childhood home of the Imperial traitor [[Kell Bircher]], she discovered the tombstones of Far and other members of the Mothma family. That discovery led Nanda and her superior [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] to understand that Bircher was in fact related to [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]], leader of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]].<ref name="SW14" />
